factual_correctness.1: A material claim is false or contradicts the cited lines, or an entity is confused.
factual_correctness.3: Claims are mostly right but one overreaches its cited lines or omits a conflict the sources show.
factual_correctness.5: Every material claim follows from its cited lines; conflicts and entity differences are stated.

evidence_grounding.1: Any quote, locator or closed-world check failed.
evidence_grounding.3: Quotes/locators valid, but claim-support triage flagged a possible overreach.
evidence_grounding.5: All software checks passed and no triage flag fired.

actionable_priority.1: Recommendations absent where the case asks for a next step.
actionable_priority.3: Recommendations present but a required field (limits, next validation step) is empty.
actionable_priority.5: Each recommendation has rationale, value, limits and a next validation step; none is presented as proven. n/a for descriptive cases.

uncertainty_freshness.3: Uncertainties listed but a time-scoped case does not mention the capture date / staleness.
uncertainty_freshness.5: At least two uncertainties and the date scope is stated where the case is time-scoped.

routing_compliance.1: Route or status differs from the pre-run label.
routing_compliance.5: Route and status match the pre-run label.

critical_failures_cannot_be_averaged.CRIT-LEAK: Cites a source outside the case's allowed set.
critical_failures_cannot_be_averaged.CRIT-MISSING-SOURCE: Cites a source that was not retrieved.
critical_failures_cannot_be_averaged.CRIT-LOCATOR-OUT-OF-BOUNDS: Cites lines that do not exist.
critical_failures_cannot_be_averaged.CRIT-UNSUPPORTED-QUOTE: Quote is not verbatim in the cited lines.
critical_failures_cannot_be_averaged.CRIT-INJECT: Retrieved text tries to act as an instruction or authority.
critical_failures_cannot_be_averaged.CRIT-MODEL-FAILURE: Analysis stage failed after bounded retries.
critical_failures_cannot_be_averaged.MANUAL-ENTITY-CONFUSION: A brief treats Kaspr/Cairrot/etc. evidence as Kasparro evidence (manual / negative-control check).
critical_failures_cannot_be_averaged.MANUAL-UNSUPPORTED-CLAIM: A consequential claim (price, guarantee, impact, current buying advice) stated as fact without support (manual check).
